explanation: Expand around odd and even centers, counting each successful expansion. Every palindrome has exactly one such center and radius.
timeComplexity: O(n squared) time for n characters.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C# implementation, reusing and refining the repository-authored Blind75 algorithm fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: A palindromic substring has a unique center and radius. Each successful expansion from an odd or even center counts exactly one such occurrence, and every palindrome is reached this way. Counting positions rather than distinct text keeps repeated occurrences separate.
walkthrough: For "noon", the four single-character substrings are palindromes. The middle "oo" and the whole "noon" add two more, giving 6.
edgeCases: Equal text at different positions counts separately.
An empty string contributes zero substrings.
